title: My experience in mall world Spencer’s with my dream world friend
content: I was in a Spencer’s gifts in the mall world last night and I remember looking at these really cool lights that were all on display on a shelf, and there was Halloween stuff all over the store so I was looking at it all but one of my friends (that I don’t know from the real world) was touching a plasma globe lamp and kept ripping ass while doing it and saying “I can’t help it, my stomach is messed up and he started laughing “ and I was getting annoyed and walking away, I walked out of the store to this large sitting area with tables and chairs arranged with 4 chairs per small table, that was really high up and I looked down the multi stories that we were up and I got dizzy, and mixed with the smell of my mall world friends fart I threw up into a trash can and I remember hearing some girls shout “eeewww”as they walked past and laughing and then hearing my buddy laughing, I looked up and saw that the ceiling was like all glass so it was a ton of sunlight coming in making me feel really warm, but there were also regular things like pipes and what not running parallel along the windows. So if anyone here was wearing a blue and white flannel with jeans, had darker skin, and kept ripping gnarly ass in Spencer’s gifts id like to reconnect with my dream world friend in the real world lol but everytime i go to this mall it’s extremely vivid and i always usually start in Spencer’s or a really large clothing store with really high ceilings, almost like I spawn here.
